# Pinokio-MCP Full Reference

MCP server for controlling Pinokio — the 1-click localhost cloud for AI apps.

## MCP Tools (portmanteau, action-discriminated)
- `app_management` — list, status, start, stop, delete apps (`action=`)
- `system_management` — ping, info, localhost_search (`action=`)
- `lww_management` — devices, start_remote for LAN instances (`action=`)
- Resources: `pinokio://apps`, `pinokio://running`, `pinokio://localhost`, `pinokio://lww/devices`
- Prompts: start workflow, cross-device, troubleshooting, available-apps

## Configuration
| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `PINOKIO_HOST` | Pinokio host | localhost |
| `PINOKIO_PORT` | Pinokio port | auto-discover |
| `PINOKIO_HOME` | Pinokio home dir | auto-discover |
